exact_statement: Let f be any Boolean function on a finite uniform cube and let T be any finite complete adaptive physical query tree, without repeated coordinates on a path, such that at each queried node and coordinate j the actual Fourier coefficients satisfy fhat(V)*fhat(V+j)=0 for every V excluding j. Each reached erasure is zero and occupied-frequency deletion gives a probability-preserving bijection pi_l from root actual support Omega to each leaf support, with physical reaches w_l summing to1. Supply ANY normalized finite-CE root Q0 and arbitrary normalized finite-CE COMPLETE leaf targets Q_l. Put q_l(S)=Q_l(pi_l(S)), G(S)=product_l q_l(S)^w_l, Z=sum_Omega G(S), and Rstar=G/Z on Omega, zero elsewhere. Then0<Z<=1 and the EXACT full signed history debit is Delta=D(P||Rstar)-D(P||Q0)-log2 Z, with -log2 Z=sum_l w_l D(pi_l Rstar||Q_l)>=0. Thus at global root reach rho>0, with all prior debits/complementary terminals W, ORIGINAL allowance A and unused U=A-W-rho*CE(P,Q0), this handoff is paid at the SAME account exactly when rho*Delta<=U; for disjoint frontier roots use sum_v rho_v*Delta_v<=U. In the matched case Q0=P, Delta>=0 and vanishes iff every full leaf target is its actual P_l. An actual three-bit Boolean f=-1 precisely at0,7 has P uniform on empty,12,13,23; querying x1 and prescribing opposite full targets(3,3,1,1)/8 and(1,1,3,3)/8 on the transported root labels yields Rstar=P but Z=sqrt(3)/2 and Delta=log2(4/3)/2>0. Hence omitting the geometric normalizer or pricing only effective-ancestor KL is false. No necessary target conversion or influence-priced initial reference is supplied; full FEI remains OPEN. Units bits.

exact_statement: For every pair of normalized finite probability laws p,q define M_i=(p_i+q_i)/2,t_i=(p_i-q_i)/(p_i+q_i), V=sum M_i*t_i^2, ignoring zero-denominator atoms. If every t_i^2<=1/2, their affinity a=sum sqrt(p_i*q_i) satisfies V/(2 ln2)<=-log2(a)<=V. Both constants and the upper squared radius1/2 are sharp. For every finite complete adaptive fair physical isospectral Boolean query tree, pull each full finite-cost terminal reference back to occupied root support, obtaining subprobability q_l of mass m_l, normalize R_l=q_l/m_l, and recursively normalize geometric child means R_v with affinities a_v. Then Z=sum_S product_l q_l(S)^(w_l) equals product_l m_l^(w_l) times product_internal a_v^(w_v). If all normalized child reference pairs obey the atomwise bound, put G=sum_l w_l*(-log2 m_l), B=sum_internal w_v*V(R_left,R_right), Rstar=R_root. The full signed target-conversion bill Delta is between D(P||Rstar)-D(P||Q0)+G+B/(2 ln2) and D(P||Rstar)-D(P||Q0)+G+B. Consequently the upper expression<=actual ORIGINAL unused allowance U=A-W-CE(P,Q0) pays every terminal conversion with all old booked W and both full physical branches retained. No influence-priced initial supplier or necessity of the selected targets is asserted; full FEI remains OPEN.
